title: Vicor to showcase power-dense, scalable DC-DC converter portfolio at Land Forces event in Perth, Australia
summary: Vicor will demonstrate how high-density power modules enable SWaP compatible power designs for defense applications
body_markdown:
Demands of rapid response are driving modern land defense innovation, where electrification is redefining the field mobility strategies and rules of engagement. To meet increasing system capabilities, defense power architecture is moving away from bulky custom subsystems toward a more interoperable, compact, modular building block approach.


Vicor enables this shift with high-density power solutions that drastically cut size and weight. Rugged power modules and VITA/SOSA-aligned supplies support the entire delivery network—from high-voltage inputs down to standard MIL-STD 270V and 28V buses. Vicor’s entire high performance portfolio of M-grade products are reliable, rugged and support SWaP specifications.


### Learn more about Vicor’s SWaP compatible products at Booth #L3-C13


Visit us at booth #L3-C13 on Level 3 to speak with our power experts, with decades of MIL-STD qualification experience. They can work closely with you define and design your application to ensure you get an optimum power supply that is tested to meet MIL-STD704, 1275, 461, 810 and others.


[Register and discover the latest, cutting-edge land defense technologies at Land Forces 2026.](https://landforces.com.au/registration/)


## About Vicor


Vicor Corporation is an American manufacturer of advanced 48V-centric DC-DC converter power modules with the highest power and current density, enabling breakthrough power delivery network performance and a competitive advantage for our customers power systems. Vicor combines innovative topologies, control systems, components and packaging into modular solutions that drive advancements in data centers, automation, robotics, mobility, test equipment and aerospace and defense applications. Vicor ensures supply chain resiliency via its vertically integrated ChiP™ fab and OEM IP licensing practice.[www.vicorpower.com](http://www.vicorpower.com/)


Vicor is a registered trademark of Vicor Corporation.


## About Land Forces 2026


As the Australia’s premier event for the land defense sector, Land Forces connects Australian and international defense, industry, government, academia, and technology leaders in support of national and regional security.


Held biennially over three days, Land Forces is a platform for engagement, featuring a comprehensive international industry exhibition, a specialist conference program with presentations and symposia from leading defense institutions, and extensive networking opportunities.


As the land domain continues to evolve through investment, and strategic partnerships, Land Forces provides a vital interface for stakeholders to explore capability development, supply chain integration, and future force design.[www.landforces.com.au](http://www.landforces.com.au/)
